title_en: The Lineage of Imam al-Mahdi in the Heritage of the Companions - Episode 2
description_en: The Lineage of Imam al-Mahdi (may God hasten his reappearance) in the Heritage of the Companions - Episode 2, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode discussing the references to the lineage of Imam al-Mahdi within the traditions and heritage of the Companions.
